news.headline: Vikings' Aaron Jones Sr. (knee) cleared to play vs. Buccaneers
news.detail: Vikings RB Aaron Jones Sr. has been cleared to start Sunday against the Tampa Bay Buccaneers after leaving Week 2's win over the Bears in a knee brace.
